title: Venue task chair - visual and functional check
scope: Visual condition and simple hand checks of a swivel task chair. No load testing, no dimensional measurement and no verification against manufacturer specifications.
safety_notes: Do not stand on the chair or the foot ring during the inspection.
Turn the chair over only on a clear, soft surface.
ai_guidance: Real swivel task chair at stool height with a foot ring, photographed at the venue. Assess only visible condition and documentation. Do not infer load capacity, gas-lift condition, fastener torque or internal mechanism condition from a photo.

requirements.title: Seat cushion upholstery
requirements.instructions: Inspect the seat upholstery for tears, cuts, punctures, peeling, open seams or flattened areas.
inspection_points: No peeling or cracking of the cover
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the whole seat from the front, slightly above, in good light.
visual_limitations: Foam condition inside the cushion is not visible.

requirements.title: Seat attached and stable
requirements.instructions: Rock the seat gently by hand and confirm it does not wobble or shift on the column.

requirements.title: Backrest mesh condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the mesh for holes, runs, sagging or edges pulled out of the frame.
recommended_actions: Report for mesh or backrest replacement
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the full backrest straight on, front or rear.
visual_limitations: Mesh tension can only be judged approximately from a photo.

requirements.title: Backrest frame condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the backrest frame, especially the corners and the lower rail, for cracks or deformation.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the rear of the backrest, including the lower rail.
visual_limitations: Hairline cracks may not be visible in a photo.

requirements.title: Left armrest secure
requirements.instructions: Push and pull the left armrest; confirm it is firm, uncracked and has no sharp edges.

requirements.title: Right armrest secure
requirements.instructions: Push and pull the right armrest; confirm it is firm, uncracked and has no sharp edges.

requirements.title: Foot ring and spokes
requirements.instructions: Check the foot ring and its three spokes for cracks, and confirm by hand that the ring does not move on the column.
inspection_points: Ring does not slip down the column
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the ring from below or the side so the spokes and collar are visible.
visual_limitations: How firmly the ring is clamped cannot be judged from a photo.

requirements.title: Height adjustment works
requirements.instructions: Raise and lower the seat with the lever; confirm it moves and holds its height without sinking.

requirements.title: Under-seat mechanism and fasteners
requirements.instructions: Look under the seat: the mechanism and its mounting plate are present, uncracked, and the visible fasteners are in place.
requirements.photo_guidance: Close photo of the mechanism and mounting plate from below.
visual_limitations: Fastener torque and internal mechanism condition cannot be verified from a photo.

requirements.title: Identification label documented
requirements.instructions: Photograph the label under the seat so it is legible, for traceability.
requirements.photo_guidance: Close, sharp photo of the label filling most of the frame.
visual_limitations: The label content is documented as-is and not verified against any database.

requirements.title: Five-star base
requirements.instructions: Inspect the five base arms and the hub for cracks or deformation.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the base from the side or slightly above so all arms are visible.
visual_limitations: Cracks on the underside of the arms are not visible from above.

requirements.title: Casters present and rolling
requirements.instructions: Confirm all five casters are present, roll and swivel freely, and none is damaged.
